bio: In this centuries-old inn in the beautiful old town, this is a truly charming alternative to the fine dining restaurant. Both the inviting, rustic-style restaurant room and fantastic inner courtyard – the 7m-long oak table is quite a unique feature – are appealing places to eat. In the evening, you can order classic dishes à la carte or opt for the Romantik set menu. Many of the ingredients are locally sourced; some of the vegetables are from their own garden, and they have their own wines. Light meals are served at lunchtime....
